Proposed diagram changes
  |-- AgentContext - implemented call flow and domain models (03f2168)  existing canvas
      |-- [4] Redraw: (O) Edit diagram with AgentContext - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Reorganize the flow around explicit or diagram-bound context resolution, generation, retained revisions, variant review and canvas application. The uploaded-context-only flow no longer explains the lifecycle.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D1] EditDiagramInput - request domain
          `-- Distinguish saved global IDs, scoped upload IDs and supplied snapshots; add edit mode, replacement scope and pinned references within the existing request structure.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D2] Diagram edit run - asynchronous execution
          `-- Add retained variants, agent-session identity and context returned after application acknowledgement.
      |-- [1b] Extend: [D3] AgentContext - implemented domain object and adapter
          `-- Add versioned source-range references, optional portable source files and resolution before model conversion; retain the separate trajectory-capture path.
      |-- [1a] Correct: [D4] Diagram-edit agent session - runtime model
          `-- Replace the in-memory session claim with persisted Pi sessions and show resolved context text entering copied history.
      `-- [1a] Correct: [D5] Revision and canvas bindings - output domain
          `-- Distinguish retained candidate revisions from installed bindings: saving a variant or selecting a presentation alternative does not rebind diagram content.
  |-- Mapping page - MCP and HTTP API  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: Mapping page: exposed interfaces at 03f2168
          `-- Replace the fixed tool inventory with the expanded generation and saved-context operations; saved IDs are not live-canvas uploads.
      `-- [1b] Extend: Mapping backend: grouped responsibilities (03f2168)
          `-- Place AgentContextLibrary beside AgentContextService, with its repository and source ports; show DiagramEditService using a matching diagram-bound context when no explicit context is supplied.
  |-- PersistentLayer  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: PersistentLayer
          `-- Add immutable saved-context records, pinned Git or hashed source storage, and compact diagram-context backing records under durable storage. Attach the new context canvas from these components.
  |-- Workspace persistence flow  existing canvas
      `-- [1b] Extend: Workspace persistence flow - baseline 03f2168
          `-- Show document.diagramContexts associations in workspace records while backing snapshots and source text remain separately stored.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw)  existing canvas
      |-- [1a] Correct: [G] DiagramService
          `-- Replace the sole-content-writer claim with explicit immutable revision operations, runtime retention and separate generation orchestration; preserve canvas-history ownership of checkpoints.
      `-- [1b] Extend: [E] CanvasHistoryService / coordinated revisions
          `-- Show issued revisions retained and checked when canvas checkpoints bind them, without making the checkpoint the generation step.
  |-- Canvas domain model - baseline 03f2168 (before tldraw) - Projection  existing canvas
      |-- [1b] Extend: [B] Diagram - immutable content and presentation
          `-- Add document.diagramContexts as fingerprint-checked associations, separate from Diagram.sourceContext evidence and content revisions.
      `-- [1a] Correct: [G] Revision operations, retention, and generation
          `-- Clarify that generation submits a validated candidate to the immutable revision operations, retention precedes publication, and canvas history owns the binding checkpoint.
  `-- [3] Saved AgentContexts and source evidence  new canvas
      |-- Context ownership and identities
          `-- Contrast scoped backend-lifetime uploads, explicitly saved global contexts and diagram-bound compiled contexts. Connect from AgentContextService in the edit call-flow canvas.
      |-- Saved-context creation and retention
          `-- Detail AgentContextLibrary request replay, immutable repository records and summary reads. Connect from AgentContextLibrary in the Mapping backend diagram.
      |-- Source capture and lazy resolution
          `-- Detail sourceId lookup, Git-commit or content-hash pinning, immutable blobs, integrity checks, portable slices and bounded expansion. Connect from FileAgentContextSources in PersistentLayer.
      `-- Diagram-bound context lifecycle
          `-- Detail evidence compilation, source fingerprint, compact backing record and generation fallback. Connect from document.diagramContexts in the Diagram projection.
